name: Statistical Society of Australia student membership
summary: Cheap SSA membership for full-time students with no income, with journal access and industry connections.
key: Full-time student membership ($25 AUD incl GST).
who: Engaged in full-time studies and without an income.
how: Join online, then email proof of full-time enrolment to the SSA Office within 14 days.
catches: Applications without proof are refunded minus a $10 admin fee.

evidence.quote: Full-time student membership ($25 AUD incl GST)
Student membership of SSA is available to those who are engaged in full-time studies and do not have an income.
